final_draft.answer: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.

I didn't run a live check, because I don't know the company's GitHub organisation name or AWS account ID. Without one, there's no evidence of what is actually enforced right now, only the approved answer and the policy. A reviewer who wants that evidence can provide the organisation name or account ID.
